## Historical audit

**Source:** A0010, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/teacher_human_archive/public_package/teacher_self_evolution_human_pilot/tasks/E01_M0_R1/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to JSONL lines in this file; offsets are half-open character ranges.

**Goal, inferred:** The code suggests constructing a furnished green room, potentially to match an external scene. The actual task prompt and any reference image are not present, so fidelity to an intended target cannot be assessed.

| Evidence | Observed operation or result |
|---|---|
| Step 1 execute, line 1 [0,11727) | Code constructs a room shell, two windows and radiators, wardrobe, multiple chairs, pedestal table, lamp, picture and tabletop objects. It specifies colors, modeled floor grain and cushion stripes, emissive glazing, chair rotations, camera and lights. These are construction instructions, not visual or geometric verification. |
| Step 1 result, line 4 [0,2274) | Build failed with `AttributeError` when accessing `ob.data.materials` on a `NoneType`; no image was returned. The logged process did not time out or exceed memory. |
| Step 2 execute, line 5 [0,10580) | The revised script retains the scene and adds mesh-type and non-null data checks to the lower-glass material loop. This is a substantive repair, not an empty patch. |
| Step 2 build and render, lines 7–10, especially line 10 [0,62078) | Build and render completed with return code 0; the result reports a saved `final.png` and `ok: true`. Line 11 [0,59) selects step 2. The image itself is not supplied for inspection. |

**Scene checks and uncertainty:** Multiple objects and component assemblies are evidenced by code and render logs. Part contact or connectivity, intersections, final pose, texture appearance, framing, lighting quality and render fidelity remain unverified. The code uses mostly specified colors and modeled detail; it does not establish convincing material or texture appearance. Camera and lights were configured, but no visual diagnosis of their effectiveness is visible.

**Teacher input and exploration:** Despite the archive path, this excerpt contains no identifiable teacher feedback, detection, diagnosis, proposed update, or student receipt/adoption. The error report is tool feedback; the subsequent guard is an observed response, not evidence of teacher instruction. The two executions show local trial and repair, but no separate autonomous exploration or visual iteration is recorded.

**Outcome:** An initial technical build failure was followed by successful build and render execution and selection. Formal scene correctness is **unknown**, not established by the success flag or object names. A transferable observation is that checking object type and data before accessing materials resolved the observed execution failure in this run. The room layout and styling are task-specific. Whether the final image matches the intended scene, and whether its parts connect and lighting reads correctly, remain unresolved hypotheses.
